summary: Today’s available coverage is mixed-to-risk-on for crypto, with Reuters showing broad strength in gold and some FX moves, while the only direct trader signal found points to BTC being at a major resistance level. The strongest fresh opportunity from the gathered material is a short-term bearish setup on Pangu from Degen Dave, plus bullish interest in TON and Notcoin from the same source; most other analyst-specific crypto names were not surfaced in today’s results.

signals.name: Bitcoin
signals.reason: Across the Sept. 17-18 and Sept. 19 livestream titles, DegenDave frames Bitcoin as rejecting resistance, facing a flush, being in trouble, and still bearish, which points to a short-term bearish bias with some bounce-watch setups.

signals.name: Ethereum
signals.reason: The Sept. 12 title explicitly calls out an ETH breakout and asks whether altcoin season is starting, which indicates a constructive directional view on Ethereum.

signals.name: Solana
